title: a board card's header stays one line high with several projects: the task id never wraps or shrinks, and the project chip stays a one-line pill that moves to its own line when it does not fit and truncates there, never a tall stretched oval
acceptance: Why. The captain reported on 2026-10-05: '船長看板上的repo氣泡框都變形了, 很難看'. Evidence (firstmate, live board on main e145ce7/d94940a, Chrome at a 1200px viewport, two projects registered: firstmate-workflow and the pilot external project): every fleet card's project chip is a tall oval and the task id is one character per line. Computed styles of `[data-task=T-219]`: `.card .hd` display:flex, width 116px; `.card .id` width 12.6px, height 75px; `.card .pchip` width 59.4px, height 75px, border-radius 99px. The chip has existed since T-054, but the defect shows only on a multi-project board (`multi()` true), which became the live case when the pilot external project was registered.

Mechanism (root cause). `.card .hd` (board/public/index.html:38) is `display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:6px` with the default `align-items:stretch` and no wrap. Its children are `.id` (index.html:82, no `white-space:nowrap`, no `flex-shrink:0`), the project chip `.pchip` (board/public/ship.css:58-60, `display:inline-block;max-width:100%;border-radius:99px;white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis`, no flex basis and no min-width:0), an optional PR link `a[data-pr]` and the `.cmenu` button (index.html:141, min-width:32px, min-height:32px). In a card about 116px wide (7 lanes, `.lanes` grid at index.html:33) the id shrinks below its text width and wraps per character, which makes the row 75px tall; `align-items:stretch` then stretches the chip to 75px, and border-radius:99px draws a tall oval.

Change. In board/public/index.html CSS (the `.card .hd` and `.card .id` rules, edited in place): `.card .hd` gets `align-items:center` and `flex-wrap:wrap` (row-gap 4px allowed); `.card .id` gets `white-space:nowrap;flex:0 0 auto`. A chip inside a card header (`.card .hd .pchip`) gets `flex:0 1 auto;min-width:0;max-width:100%;align-self:center` so the rule is: the chip stays on the id's line when its full name fits beside the id, PR link and menu; otherwise flex-wrap moves it to its own line under the id, where it truncates with its existing ellipsis if the name is wider than the card. Either way it is one line high. The PR link and `.cmenu` keep their sizes and `margin-left:auto` placement. No element in a card header is taller than its own one line of text plus its padding and border, except `.cmenu` at its 32px touch target. ship.css `.pchip` stays as is. The roster's `.pj pchip` cell (board/public/ship.js:174) needs no change: on wide screens the roster row is a grid with `align-items:center` (ship.css:72-75) and `.roster li.rrow .l1{display:contents}` (ship.css:83), so the chip cannot stretch; on phones (ship.css:103-106, `@media(max-width:640px)`) the cell deliberately shows its `data-label` as a block `::before` line above the name, the designed 'labelled cells wrap across three lines' (design.md §8, 'The crew'), and that stays.

Every place the board draws `.pchip` keeps a one-line pill (grep `chip(` in board/public/index.html and `pchip` in board/public/ship.js): lane card headers (index.html:536), the drop confirm line (index.html:590), history and merged-column cards (index.html:604, the `.hd` with id, chip and stage label), the merging list (index.html:632), decision strip summaries (index.html:641), decision card meta `whose()` (index.html:669) and roster rows (ship.js:174). Only the lane/history card header is known to deform; the others are inline text where the chip is already inline-block and one line high, and must stay so.

Test (fail-first; workers do not run suites; CI's e2e job and the gates verify). New test in tests/e2e/board-layout.spec.ts (or a new tests/e2e/board-chips.spec.ts in the same style: fixture `test`, `makeRoot`, `writeProjects`, `writeTasks`, `startBoard`/`stopBoard`, no screenshots). Register two projects with realistic long names (`firstmate-workflow` style is the engine root; add `the pilot external project` via `writeProjects`) so every card shows a chip; put cards in at least ready, review and merged lanes, one with a PR so `a[data-pr]` is in the header. At viewport 1200x900 and at 390x844: for every visible `.card .hd .pchip`, its bounding-box height is at most 1.6 x its computed font size, concretely `height <= parseFloat(getComputedStyle(el).fontSize) * 1.6 + 4` (padding and border); for every `.card .id`, its height is at most `fontSize * 1.6 + 2` (one line) and `scrollWidth <= clientWidth + 1` (not cut); for every `.card .hd`, no child except `.cmenu` is taller than that bound. Same height bound for every other `.pchip` on the page (roster, decision meta, strips, merging list) at 1200x900. At 390x844 the roster's `.pj.pchip` is exempt (its block `::before` label is the designed two-line phone cell, ship.css:105-106); the other chips keep the bound there too. Also, at 1200x900, a card whose chip holds the long name has that chip either on the id's line or wholly below it (chip top >= id bottom - 1), never overlapping. On current main the 1200px case fails (chip 75px tall).

Callers, mirrors and fixtures checked: `grep -rn pchip board/ tests/` gives index.html:315 (`chip`), ship.css:58,67, ship.js:174, tests/ship.spec.ts:224 and tests/board-identity.test.sh:113-115 (assert the roster cell's class string `pj pchip`, unaffected because no markup changes), tests/e2e/board-projects.spec.ts (text and title of chips, unaffected), tests/e2e/board-pr-links.spec.ts:79 (no chips on a one-project board, unaffected). No markup, class name or data attribute changes, so no test string changes; tests/e2e/board-layout.spec.ts existing assertions about lane count and card layout must still hold.

Design (edit in place, no new section at the end, T-189). design/design.md §8 'The captain's board' (design.md:1666), subsection '### The crew' (design.md:1970): the paragraph at design.md:2001-2008 ('The roster shows separate columns ... card project chips') gains one sentence: a card header stays one line high: the task id never wraps or shrinks, and the project chip is a one-line pill that truncates, or moves to its own line in a narrow card.
Out of scope: lane count or widths, the `.lanes` grid breakpoints, chip colours (`SHIP.projectColor`), roster columns, any server or data change, and the voyage panel.
